This skill should be used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces, including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 80 searchable styles (51 active), 194 product palettes and reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 141 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 stacks.
